dct_description_sm: Each dataset is an excel file, with a worksheet of raw data and a worksheet of metadata, explaining each data column.

Three datasets on box occupancy, nesting success and phenology, and individual morphometrics of tree swallows from the long-term box-nesting population at QUBS. All data collected and compiled by Raleigh Robertson, Frances Bonier, Amelia Cox, Wallace Rendell, and dozens of trainees and field assistants.
dct_title_s: Historical Tree Swallow dataset from long-term monitoring at QUBS
